name: icon
label: Icon name
hint: Enter a Font Awesome icon name without the 'fa fa-' prefix. Example: shield, calendar, desktop, check-circle.

name: icon_class
label: Custom icon class
hint: Optional. Overrides Icon name. Example: fa fa-shield.

name: icon_color
label: Custom icon color
hint: Optional CSS color. Example: #ce1126. Leave blank to use the selected color scheme.

name: icon_background
label: Custom icon background
hint: Optional CSS color. Example: #fae7e9. Leave blank to use the selected color scheme.

name: title_color
label: Custom title color
hint: Optional CSS color. Leave blank to use the widget default.

name: callout_color
label: Custom callout color
hint: Optional CSS color. Leave blank to use the callout style or widget default.

name: subtitle_color
label: Custom subtitle color
hint: Optional CSS color. Leave blank to use the widget default.

name: card_background
label: Custom card background
hint: Optional CSS color. Leave blank for white.

name: border_color
label: Custom border color
hint: Optional CSS color. Leave blank to use the state or widget default.

name: aria_label
label: Accessibility label
hint: Optional. If blank, the widget automatically builds a label from the title, callout, and subtitle.

name: allow_wrap
label: Allow text wrapping
hint: Enable when titles, callouts, or subtitles may be longer than the available card width.
